MR-03.notes: Mechanism exists and is tested (cutting the pathway gives exactly 0; FD). Amendment standard not met: under the default the bootstrap mix stayed 1 in every integrated and real-configuration run, so R_psi had exactly zero weight in live inner updates (RW: TV 0.0 on 11 real live updates). Influence occurred only in the controlled diagnostic after an evidence-based lowering to 0.75, and D-RW2 shows the validity walk cannot go below 0.75 where the bootstrap ties at reward time (probe: 50/50 runs with a perfect R_psi stop at 0.75). D-RW1: in RW's own controlled configuration an equally likely UNLEARNED R_psi (negated output layer, reward step 0) was promoted in 3 of 12 cases (learned at the agent's step 1e-4: 2 of 6), with post-promotion effects -0.77 [-2.10, 0.60] and +1.04 [0.71, 1.39]; so neither promotion nor its effect is attributable to meta-learning at the agent's step.
